title: Enchanters Eye
description: Can be inscribed with a spell at the inscription table.

The enchanter's eye can cast spells remotely through a §5scry crystal!§r Use the eye directly on the scry crystal to set a single location, or hold a bound §5scry parchment§r in your offhand to allow for multiple locations.
The enchanter's eye will cast the inscribed spell through the scry crystal, similar to a spell turret, though the spell is considered to have been cast directly by the player when using the eye.
